decisions.reason: Ties v0.9.5's absence to the branch-only sync script (HEAD:main, never tags) and the immediate ref-resolution failure, explicitly ruling out network, typo and npm-package causes.
States the direction: v0.9.7 (alpha.1 client API, useConversation) is ahead of the frozen rc.2 host; explains why install success and restarts prove nothing about API compatibility.

Selects v0.9.3 via rc.1 verification + additive rc.2 note, notices v0.9.3 is also absent from the mirror, sequences maintainer tag push before the #v0.9.3 install command, conditional SHA fallback, no DSH upgrade.
Pushes release tags to every mirror in the sync script (explicit refs/tags refspec or --tags backfill) plus per-mirror ls-remote verification gates and README-tag CI checks.

Compat matrix, machine-checkable gating, per-row commands and rejection of the newest-tag default are all present, but 'dsh 0.1.2-alpha.1+ → #v0.9.7' and '>=0.1.2-alpha.1' route untested future alphas to v0.9.7, which the rubric forbids.
